from cache import LRUCache


def test_invalidate_prefix_removes_matching_string_keys_and_returns_count():
    c = LRUCache(10)
    c.set("user:1", 1)
    c.set("user:2", 2)
    c.set("team:1", 3)
    assert c.invalidate_prefix("user:") == 2
    assert list(c.items) == ["team:1"]


def test_non_string_keys_are_untouched():
    c = LRUCache(10)
    c.set(10, "numeric")
    c.set("10:a", "string")
    assert c.invalidate_prefix("10") == 1
    assert c.get(10) == "numeric"
    assert c.get("10:a") is None


def test_remaining_lru_order_is_preserved():
    c = LRUCache(10)
    for key in ["a:1", "keep:1", "a:2", "keep:2"]:
        c.set(key, key)
    c.get("keep:1")
    before = [k for k in c.items if not (isinstance(k, str) and k.startswith("a:"))]
    c.invalidate_prefix("a:")
    assert list(c.items) == before


def test_no_match_returns_zero():
    c = LRUCache()
    c.set("x", 1)
    assert c.invalidate_prefix("nope") == 0
    assert c.get("x") == 1

from rules import RuleTable


def test_exact_rule_remains_exact_only():
    rules = RuleTable()
    rules.add_exact("team", "exact")
    assert rules.resolve("team") == "exact"
    assert rules.resolve("team.alpha") is None


def test_exact_wins_over_namespace():
    rules = RuleTable()
    rules.add_namespace("team.", "namespace")
    rules.add_exact("team.alpha", "exact")
    assert rules.resolve("team.alpha") == "exact"


def test_longest_namespace_wins():
    rules = RuleTable()
    rules.add_namespace("team.", "broad")
    rules.add_namespace("team.ops.", "specific")
    assert rules.resolve("team.ops.deploy") == "specific"
    assert rules.resolve("team.dev") == "broad"


def test_unknown_key_is_none():
    rules = RuleTable()
    rules.add_namespace("known.", "x")
    assert rules.resolve("other.value") is None
